description: Derin uzayda yaşanabilir yeni dünyalar keşfetmeye var mısınız? Uzayın derinliklerinde bilmediğimiz o büyüleyici yolculukta nelere ihtiyacımız var? Bizi bekleyen tehlikeler neler? İnsanlık için atacağımız bu büyük adımda bizimle aynı heyecanı yaşamaya bekliyoruz. Bu konuda İnci kefalinden ilham aldık. Niye mi; Van Gölünde yaşayan endemik bir tür olan inci kefali tıpkı somun balıkları gibi yıllık göç yapıyor, o yıl çıkan larvalar büyüyor ve anayurtlarına geri dönüyorlar.
summary: Utilizing data from NASA and the Turkish Space Agency (TUA), the game offers an accessible browser-based platform designed for students, teachers, and space enthusiasts. Future development plans include adding more star systems, expanding the real-world data archive, and introducing a specialized classroom mode.
details:
Functionality & How It Works

  • Core Gameplay: Galaxy Explorer is a 3D space exploration game where players pilot a spaceship through a star system, tracking their progress using instant speed and fuel indicators.
  • Scanning & Archiving: Players look at planets, scan them to learn what they are, and automatically add new entries to their discovery archive.

Controls: The game utilizes WASD for movement, mouse for looking around, Shift to speed up, E to scan, and J to open the archive.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Transforming Learning: It replaces passive learning (such as just reading about planets) with an active, interactive experience that makes hard-to-imagine space distances and scales easier to grasp.
  • For Students: It guides learners to explore planets and galaxies, assisting people in the future.
  • For Teachers: It provides a classroom tool that teachers can open to help students acquire knowledge in an engaging way.
  • For Everyone: It offers an accessible browser-based space where anyone can explore and examine 3D space visuals.

Tools & Technologies Used

  • Data Sources: The project incorporates real space data from NASA and the Turkish Space Agency (TUA).
  • AI & Development: The team used ChatGPT to help write the game code (detecting and fixing faulty code themselves) and Claude to assist with presentation stages and refining ideas.

Creativity & Design Factors

  • Addressing the Challenge: The team considered how difficult it is to imagine space and think about distances using numbers alone, recognizing that learners need a clear path to discover, scan, and learn.
  • Immersive Experience: By designing a cockpit view where players fly and manage fuel relative to their target system, the project brings a true sense of the exploration passion to users.
dataRefs: Visualize a Space Mission Using Virtual Reality
